Felix Diallo
felix.diallo@example.com | Raleigh, NC
Felix Diallo has 6 years of experience in mobile. Most recently, Senior Mobile
Engineer at Nimbus Cloud (2025-2026), where they built the company's Swift app
end to end, shipped to 144K users. Before that, Mobile Engineer at Quartzline
Digital (2023-2025). Before that, Junior Mobile Engineer at Wrenfield Computing
(2020-2023). Education: M.S. Computer Engineering, University of Texas at
Dallas, 2019; B.S. Computer Engineering, NC State University, 2016. Core
skills: AWS, Swift, Node.js, REST API design, React Native, GraphQL,
TypeScript, TypeScript, Kotlin, Node.js.
